verdict.rationale: Carta's API has a documented 'create draft option grant' endpoint. It defines a draft option grant as one that 'has not yet received board consent and approval' (carta-docs-22), which matches the story's draft-then-board-approve pattern. An agent can call it headlessly using the OAuth client-credentials flow, which needs no explicit user permission (carta-docs-6, carta-docs-7). Missing for 10: evidence of how drafts reach and move through the human board-approval queue, write or drafting support in the MCP plugins (documented only for querying), a non-alpha endpoint (it sits under v1alpha1), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
